Artwork: Brigitte G. H. Taylor

Christmas revue · cabaret, Disney, musical theatre, gospel

Santa is running late… so the cabaret takes over!

Expressive Singing’s master of ceremonies tries to get hold of Santa, but a flurry of calls and messages soon turns the evening into a Christmas revue filled with songs, surprises and festive fun. Across four acts and a grand finale, enjoy a lively journey from cabaret to Disney, musical theatre and gospel.

During the interval, browse the stalls at our Christmas market, supporting a good cause. Join us in Geneva for a festive evening the whole family can enjoy.

  • DateSunday 20 December 2026
  • TimesDoors 16:00 · Show 17:00–19:00
  • VenueSalle Trocmé, Rue du Jura 2, 1201 Genève
  • TicketsUp to CHF 22 · free for children aged 5 and under
  • OrganiserExpressive Singing Association
